scope: Read-only source feasibility, no chain or service executed

findings.finding: Official EthCheatCodes reorg(depth)/reorgTo use anvil_rollback; reorgWithReplacement(depth,[]) uses anvil_reorg at unchanged L1 height. The latter does not itself pause mining: wrap execWithPausedAnvil only after parent manual miner is fully stopped. reorgTo computes currentTip-target+1; avoid ambiguous off-by-one by explicit verified depth. Viem snapshot/revert also exist (actions/test/snapshot.js20,revert.js21), but live-node external storage is not restored by evm_revert and backward timestamps complicate freshness.

node.getSequencer().pause() awaits loop and all pending L1 publication before return, restartable via start(). node.pauseSequencer() server.js1113-1127 only changes minTxsPerBlock and is not this drain barrier. Keep existing miner running until graceful pause finishes; then stop it before reorg. Existing drainT04Checkpoints u01-browser-flow.js58-75 verifies L1 pending checkpoint and node proposed/checkpointed agreement but automatically resumes; reuse its exact assertions in the parent-owned paused interval, not a new lifecycle.
Actual L1 archive mismatch walks checkpoints back to matching archive and removes descendants. No fake headers, direct store mutation or forced node rollback is needed.
chain-pruned invokes native unwindBlocks; wait for actual status and canonical tips to converge before wallet reads.

Ordinary pxe.sync handles chain-pruned transactionally across registered rollback stores, resets anchor and advances event cursor only after success. pxe.js120-128 includes private events, notes, facts and tagging stores. No manual cache clearing.
rollbackTo behind finalized rejects unless force clears worldstate/P2P. Force is inappropriate acceptance; preserve all finalized setup, never mark suffix proven/finalized.

Pruned mined txs may return to pending; receipt disappearance does not imply permanent drop. InvalidTxsAfterReorgRule.js28-67 evicts transactions whose anchor hash was pruned after actual worldstate sync. Deliberately anchor the target marker proof in a disposable empty checkpoint that is also removed; verify actual outcome rather than manually deleting pool entries.

Prior canonical receipt rechecked before new action; lost confirmed intent fences writes. Product application has no exposed explicit conflict replacement path. Do not clear journals or restart empty journal to continue writes. Read-only recovery remains possible. preserve old included receipt/effect/fee plus new orphan status separately.

Contract derives read marker hash from canonical private archive; caller cannot inject hash. Reader authenticates encrypted checkpoint, increments epoch/reset fold on removed anchor, validates all private-event canonical block hashes and read marker hashes. A marker referencing a removed ancestor is ordinarily removed with its descendant tx; do not manufacture orphanedReadMarkers>0 expectation by changing hash responses.

minimumScenario: Existing activated-board/private-fee parent, real proofs and real-wall miner, one fresh human, same trusted HTTP/PXE and encrypted store. Keep one retained public root and all L1 funding outside reorg suffix. Capture retained checkpoint R/L1 tip T, hashes, proven/finalized tips and private fee baseline. Finalized<=R required.

Produce one genuine empty checkpoint X after R using existing fixture checkpoint scope. Drain publication; anchor wallet to X. Submit exactly one production mark_thread_read(root,through_block=X) private-fee action. Save exact canonical included receipt/effect, private fee delta and public footprint; assert target transaction anchor equals X. Complete encrypted reader and save ciphertext through normal store, not plaintext preferences in evidence.

While miner active call graceful sequencer.pause; verify node proposed=checkpointed and actual L1 pending checkpoint matches, no pending publication/txpool uncertainty. Stop existing miner and verify it stopped. Persist local reorg intent containing public cut anchors and hashes. Before mutating assert retained R>=finalized and all target suffix unfinalized.

Execute one execWithPausedAnvil(()=>reorgWithReplacement(currentL1Tip-T,[])) using original disposable L1 only. Read actual unchanged height and changed suffix hashes, R anchor unchanged, onchain rollup pending rollback. Keep sequencer paused; resume the same parent miner in a sequential scope, never overlapping. Ordinary real-wall timestamps, no clock override.

Within bounded45s wait actual archiver pending chain and worldstate prune to R (or another explicitly verified retained canonical boundary); pxe.sync, check private preference head rolled back and target receipt/effect no longer canonical. Invalid-anchor transaction must not silently reinclude. If propagation/eviction cannot be established, fail with safe partial evidence.

Hot production readPreferences must increment cache epoch and reconstruct retained private state, old read marker absent. Close/reopen actor via existing trusted key restore and SAME encrypted journal/cache, compare read result; optional empty preference cache in a separate fresh read-only store exercises full authenticated scan, never authorizes send. Restore public index from existing SQLite cache and sync actual chain if parent already owns index.

Keep archived inclusion evidence immutable, reconcile canonical fee totals excluding orphaned fee and assert actual private FPC balance restored. Save current lost intent state. Assert no extra proof/submission from hot/cold read and that new action remains fenced; do not call recoverSaved automatically (it can submit valid dropped bytes). Finish existing cleanup with preserved journal, no forced deletion/reproof/replay.

budget.admission: Require >=90000ms remaining before committing to reorg; otherwise fail bounded feasibility, never extend deadline. Existing setup/funding/catchup remains the dominant cost. Exact duration requires one new measured run; current active preference run has not been inspected or altered.
budget.laterWrites: New replacement preference/marker after lost intent requires separately reviewed explicit recovery API. Do not silently weaken no-replay gates.

mandatoryFollowOnRecovery.minimalInterfaceProposal: Separate read-only reconcileOrphaned(intentId) returning fixed orphaned-state-conflict or unresolved (preserve immutable earlier inclusion and current evidence), followed by explicit user-invoked prepareReplacement(intentId) that uses journal.allowReplacement on the SAME operation and same immutable business intent, records prior exact hash and reason durably, resimulates current revision/fee under the normal trusted factory, then requires existing explicit submitPrepared. Recheck every old attempt immediately before new proof/send. Reuse existing encrypted journals and CAS; no new database. Read-marker throughBlock that is absent or changed requires explicit user acknowledgement of the new canonical marker context; never silently substitute a read position. Detailed nonce/application-nullifier invariants require independent review before implementation.
mandatoryFollowOnRecovery.acceptance: A genuine orphaned confirmed intent must remain inspectable/recoverable after restart, explicit replacement alone can make progress when every prior attempt is provably invalid, and pending/unavailable/reincluded cases remain fenced. This is mandatory following product repair if no current API fulfills it, not optional scope removal.
